paragraphs: Rabbi Zekharyah, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s son-in-law. In Naso Rabbah 9; Jerusalem Talmud, Kilayim 1:8; Pesachim 1:1, 2:2; Kiddushin 1:4; Shekalim 5:6; Sotah 1:4; Ketubbot 1, end of halakhah 1:Zekharyah, Rabbi Levi’s son-in-law. Likewise end of Jerusalem Talmud, Peah:Levi’s son-in-law, who took charity and gave it to others. Thus Yuchasin’s “son-in-law of Yehoshua ben Levi” is a scribal error. Shocher Tov, end of chapter 2:Zevadyah—a scribal error for Zekharyah—Levi’s son-in-law, in Levi’s name.
